title: Pink Cornflower - 2x Mini Plugs - Hardy Annual
description:
The Pink Cornflower Mini Plugs are hardy annual plants that thrive in a temperate climate. These versatile plants, suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, bloom in the summer with beautiful pink flowers. Easy to grow and fast-growing, these mini plugs are perfect for adding a pop of colour to your garden or patio. Ideal for those looking to enjoy the beauty of nature in the United Kingdom, these flowering herbs are a delightful addition to any garden.
